title: Drainage Myth vs. Fact: Chemical Cleaners
description: Many property owners believe that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a slow-running drain is the safest and easiest troubleshooting method. However, professional plumbers know that these products can generate excessive heat, potentially damaging PVC pipes or corroding older metal infrastructure. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the clog, standing caustic liquid creates a severe safety hazard for anyone servicing the line. Professional diagnosis, mechanical cabling, or hydro-jetting remain the proper methods for clearing stubborn blockages without compromising pipe integrity or safety.
caption:
Drainage Myth vs. Fact: Chemical Cleaners

Many property owners believe that pouring harsh chemical drain cleaners down a slow-running drain is the safest and easiest troubleshooting method. However, professional plumbers know that these products can generate excessive heat, potentially damaging PVC pipes or corroding older metal infrastructure. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the clog, standing caustic liquid creates a severe safety hazard for anyone servicing the line. Professional diagnosis, mechanical cabling, or hydro-jetting remain the proper methods for clearing stubborn blockages without compromising pipe integrity or safety.
